Police Liberation War museum opens in Ctg
2022-03-25T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/police-liberation-war-museum-opens-ctg-2990026

Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan inaugurated Police Liberation War museum in Chattogram yesterday.

CMP set up the museum "Police Mukhtijuddho Jadughar" at Dampara Police Lines in the old building of British army, which was attacked by Surya Sen and his associates in 1930.

The museum depicts the role of police officers who sacrificed their lives in 1971.
